name: Colour Picker
hint: Drag the square or hue strip. The dashed line marks AA contrast.
description: Saturation/brightness square, hue strip, hex entry, swatches and a live WCAG contrast check. A dashed AA line on the square shows where the colour stops being readable against your background.
usage: Use where someone picks one colour (a brand colour, a label colour). Pass `value` + `onChange` (or `defaultValue`), a `label`, and set `contrastWith` to the background the colour will sit on, so the AA line and badges tell the truth. `onChange` receives a lowercase #rrggbb hex. In a <form> give it a `name` and the hex is submitted; a reset returns to `defaultValue`. It is `width` px wide (280) and never wider than its container; on phones it grows to 360px, and its swatches and hue strip have 44px-tall touch boxes.

dataProps.description: Controlled colour, a hex (#rrggbb or #rgb). Pass it with onChange; leave it undefined to let the picker keep its own.
Colour on first render when uncontrolled, and what a form reset returns to.
